title: Ganpati Making Competition at GEA

photo.alt: Students and guests come together during the prize distribution ceremony of the Ganpati Making Competition at GEA Interact School.

summary: Rotary Club of Deonar sponsored prizes for the Ganpati Making Competition at GEA Interact School, encouraging students to express their creativity while celebrating the spirit of Ganeshotsav.
description:
Rotary Club of Deonar sponsored prizes for the Ganpati Making Competition at GEA Interact School, encouraging students to express their creativity while celebrating the spirit of Ganeshotsav. The initiative provided an opportunity for young students to showcase their artistic talent, creativity and enthusiasm through the making of Ganpati idols.
The prize distribution ceremony brought together students, teachers and representatives of Rotary Club of Deonar. Students who participated in the competition were recognised and felicitated for their creativity and effort. Rtn. Naresh Shenoy was also involved in the initiative, supporting the Club's efforts to encourage student participation and engagement.
The event created a warm and encouraging environment for the young participants and reinforced the Club's commitment to supporting creative, cultural and educational activities at its Interact schools.
The Club appreciates the continued support of (Nandu) Rtn. Naresh Shenoy.
